articleTitle: A Novel Printed Fractal Log-Periodic Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: This paper presents the research on a novel miniaturized printed log-periodic antenna with fractal tree structure for operation in a broadband of 0.4 GHz-2GHz. The antenna is designed and simulated with the application of CST MICROWAVE STUDIO<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>software based on the Finite Integral Method. The simulation results show that the antenna achieves the necessary lateral size reduction to 61% of the normal log-periodic antenna, while keeping its radiation characteristics nearly constant.

articleTitle: Calculation of a High Frequency Rectangular Film Resistor Inductance
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: On the basis of decomposition and current strips methods the matrix method of calculation inductive and inter-inductive parameters of the equivalent circuit of high-power microwaves film resistors is submitted. To growth of frequency there is a redistribution of a current in cross section of the film resistor. As thus magnetic interaction between separate sites of cross section changes equivalent inductance of a resistive film also changes. In this work the algorithm of calculation of the equivalent inductance taking into account non-uniform distribution of currents is given. It is shown that at thickness of a film much less than skin layer and preservation of parameters of blocks on which the cross section is broken, equivalent inductance decreases on 5% in comparison with inductance on zero frequency.

articleTitle: A Log-Periodic Bow-Tie Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications

articleTitle: Parameters Optimization Algorithm of a New Type of Diffraction Optics Elements
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A new methods of construction and optimization of diffraction optics elements with square zones topology which allow to greatly reduce a sidelobe level by rotating square zones relative to each other are presented. The method of finding maximal of sidelobe level using multiple runs of local search algorithms and zones rotation angles optimization algorithm based on principles of optimizing multiextremal table functions were used. So these elements, for example in microelectronics and THz waveband, can be produced on standard equipment used in chips manufacture.

Author Keywords: multiple runs of local search algorithms

articleTitle: Short-Pulse Microwave Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: The paper concerns a system for detecting cross section of an object under test. The object is located on a revolving platform and excited with ultra short pulses. The cross section is calculated on a base of matrix constituted by the signal received coherently for different angles. Phase shift between pulses is key information in those calculations.

articleTitle: Elimination of Multipath Fading in Point-to-Point Communication
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: We describe a technique to eliminate multipath fading in point to point communications. The technique exploits our ability to control relative phase between desired signals arriving in the antenna beam and of undesired multipath signals coming from outside of the beam direction. Using out ability to control relative phase, we can in principle reduce the destructive interference know as multipath fading to arbitrarily small values.

articleTitle: Estimation of Noise Immunity of Invariant Message Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: There are some relations in the theory of communication named as invariants in terms of which noise immune (or invariant) to any kind of noise error communication systems are constructed. However the known approach has the following disadvantages: — By using relative amplitude modulation (RAM) in its classical representation with fluctuation noise, noise immunity appears to be very low. — Using invariants does not give the desirable result in increasing noise immunity in classical amplitude modulation. Free from the above mentioned disadvantages algorithm is presented below.

articleTitle: Information Security Services in the Millimeter-Wave Computer Network with Wireless Access
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A new possibilities in the field of information security services in the microwave and millimeter waveband (including THz) computer network with wireless access and indoor systems are offered and discussed.

articleTitle: A Method of the Unique Description of Finite-State Gibbs Models
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A new approach to determining of unique parameter vector for finite-state Gibbs models of Markov random fields is proposed.

articleTitle: Particle Waves in Electron Beams
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Space-time ratios in electronic beams are examined. Expression for distances between electrons in the accelerated beam is received. The criterion of existence of particle waves is received.

articleTitle: Influence of Photolithography Mistakes on Characteristics of Ftsp Transducer
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: An influence of photolithography mistakes which are arisen as a result of planar shift of aluminum terminals formed on the surface of silicon chip is described. The planar shift of these terminals away from one of symmetry axis of Greek Cross shaped Four-Terminal Silicon Piezoresistive (FTSP) Transducer is considered. Some physical features of anisotropic behavior of deformed silicon under the applied mechanical pressure are taken into consideration. Both cases of power supplying of FTSP transducer with constant voltage supply and constant current supply are analyzed. All calculations were carried out with Couple-Field Finite-Element Method (FEM) realized in ANSYS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TM</sup>software. It follows from calculations that photolithography mistakes can bring a significant investment into the deviation of characteristics of FTSP transducer.

articleTitle: Passive Microwave Devices Based on LTCC and Sandwich Multilayer Technologies
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Application of LTCC and sandwich multilayer technologies to a design of microwave integrated circuits is considered. Potential benefits for microwave applications are discussed. Design of LTCC and sandwich based MICs of bandpass filters, directional couplers, and a fully integrated front-end module for wireless systems is presented.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of the Helical Passive Electromagnetic Pulse Generator
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: In this paper, based on circuit equations, we analyze in detail the operating principles and spectrum properties of output currents of the helical passive electromagnetic pulse generator with capacitive and inductive load respectively. Finally, we demonstrate that the generator with capacitive load has a wider waveband, making it more suitable as a wideband radiation source.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Measurement Method of S-Parameters of Passive Microwave Devices by Double Six-Port Reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A method of measurement parameters of microwave devices of communication by six-port reflectometer is considered, the problem of the determination relations waves of the voltages when the signals from two generators passed through double six-port-reflectometer simultaneous influence on inputs of the measured two-port generator signals is solved.

Author Keywords: transmitted and incident waves of the voltage

articleTitle: Nonlinear Two-Port Network DC Model for Fet
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: On base of the decomposition of function from many varyables on simple in dimensions functions a classification of nonlinear models is entered for a family of the formal models of nonlinear devices in class of Volterra-Wiener systems. DC models for FET are built as nonlinear two-port networks in classes A, AB, B and C operations. Bernstein polynoms are used for the monotone approximation of measured output and transfer characteristics, which can be used in further identification processes.

articleTitle: Electric Characteristics of Rebuilt Quaisipolynomial Microwave Bandstop Filters
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Results of natural and computing experiments with creation of electric rebuilt quaisipolynomial bandstop microwave filters are submitted.

articleTitle: The Investigation of the Psk Signal Passage Through the Selective Filter with the High Suppression of the Signals in the Adjacent Channels of the Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: To improve the management of the frequency resource in the multi-channel section of the telecommunication system, the selectitve systems (SS) with high rectangularity of AFC are used. At that AFC and PFC for SS could have a complicated character [1]. In the given work the selective system with the high slope grade of AFC at its relatively smooth form was synthesized. The response of such a filter for PSK signal with the rectangular envelope of the elements was examined, and also the degree of squeezing from the adjacent channels at the relatively small overlap of filters AFC of the adjacent channels.

articleTitle: Determination of the Circuit Pulse Characteristic of a Circuit Having Nonlinear Phase Response
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: It is consider the pulse characteristic calculation method of the communication channel which has the nonlinear phase response, based on PR approximation by part-linear function.

articleTitle: An Influense of Passive Noises on Radar Detection Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: The correlations for analysis of radar with selector of moving targets detection characteristics working during an influence of passive noises from turbulent meteors, is given.

articleTitle: Research on the Possibility for Reflexotherapy MW Irradiator to Increase MW Electromagnetic Oscillations Penetration Depth into Biological Tissue
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: The results of calculations of MW electromagnetic (EM) oscillations penetration depth into biological tissue (BT) under treatment by MW irradiator for reflexotherapy are discussed. The irradiator was made of the segment of coaxial waveguide. It is shown that in order to satisfy the reflexotherapy requirements on locality and MW EM oscillations penetration depth into BT it is necessary to use coaxial waveguide having inner electrode radius ∼0.5 mm and outer electrode radius of ∼1 - 1.5 mm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hall Factor in Isotropic Polysilicon
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A model of isotropic polycrystal is proposed. All crystallites are regarded as spheres having the same diameter d. The distance between the centers of the spheres cannot be less than d. The distribution of the centers of the crystallites in the polycrystal is described by the radial distribution function given by the rigid spheres model. In the framework of the model the charge carriers relaxation time τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf>on potential barriers, taking place at the surfaces of the crystallites, is dependent only on energy ε of the charge carrier (τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf>= τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf>(ε)). The calculation of the Hall-factor caused by the scattering on the potential barriers in the polycrystalline silicon is presented.

articleTitle: Research of Influence of the Conducting Interchannel Crosspiece on Transfer of the Image Through Microchannel Plate
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Method of the theory of electrical circuits is investigated influence of resistance and situation of a conducting crosspiece between channels on factors of amplification of a current in channels and transfer of contrast of the image

articleTitle: A Circular Monopole Ulrta-Wideband Antenna
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: This paper presents a circular monopole UWB antenna, which has an approximately 30 times octave bandwidth constant group delay, acceptable gain flatness and high efficiency, and introduces the primary antenna design. In this paper, the theoretical analysis, simulation by CST Microwave Studio and experiments are all conducted to further characterize the antenna in terms of the influences on its performance by varying the dimension parameters of the antenna. Also, via the experiments, this paper originally presents the idea of improving the impedance bandwidth by modifying the structure of feeding network.

articleTitle: A New Possibilities of a Flat and Conformal FZP Lens and Antennas in Communications, Indoor Techniques, Wireless and Information Protection
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A new possibilities of a flat and conformal FZP-like lens and antennas in communications, indoor techniques, wireless and information security are offered and discussed.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Several Slot-Coupled Microstrip Antennas
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Four miniaturized microstrip antennas with slots are discussed. It is proved that the four designs of slot-coupled patches lead to the size reduction of 20%, 22%, 33%and38% separately compared with conventional types, but at the same time, the other characteristics of the radiation are to some extent deteriorated such as gain, band width, and lobe width. And the penetrating analysis on how the shapes of the slots influence the characters of antenna is summarized as well.

articleTitle: Potencial Benefits of Left/Right-Handed Transmission Lines for Microwave Applications
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Original design of a broadband digital phase shifter based on switching between transmission lines with positive and negative dispersion is presented. A simple approach to design phase shifters with the operational bandwidth, which can be extended to one octave regarding both the phase shift and the input matching, is considered. Artificial transmission line with the negative dispersion was implemented as quasi-lumped-element coplanar structure using a multilayer technology. The simulated and measured performance of the 180° phase shifter is presented.

articleTitle: Increasing to Accuracy of the Measurement Microwave Parameters by Six-Port Reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A new method of increasing to accuracy of the measurement microwave parameters devices of communication by six-port reflectometer are considered.

Author Keywords: equations of the calibration and measurement

articleTitle: Geometrical Model of Communication
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: There are different classes of communication channels with variable parameters. Nowadays the following models of such communication channels are known: 1. With casually changing signal phase. 2. With smooth (general) fading. 3. With multiplicative noise error. 4. With selective fading. Each class is characterized by its own model that makes it difficult to generally analyze a communication channel with variable parameters. In this connection the necessity arises to construct a universal model for identification of channels of all classes. A universal geometrical model of a communication channel with variable parameters, including the models mentioned above, is offered.

articleTitle: CAD Tools for Designing of Diffraction Flat and Conformal Antennas
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: The system of automatic CAD design of diffraction antennas operates in dialog mode is development. The examples of a CAD design of different antennas are presented.

articleTitle: The Method of Dripping Weakening of the Psk Signals Into the Adjacent Frequency Channels of the Information Transmission Telecommunication System
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: In an important case of the telemetric information transmission by means of PSK signals with the frequency multiplexing, the signal dripping from the adjacent channels may be the cause of false information. As it is impossible to predict such a result with the purpose of introducing a corresponding correction, it is advisable to select the type of signal with which the penetration into the adjacent channels would be minimum. It is shown in the report that dripping effect can be minimized at the use of radio-impulses with smooth envelope as the elements of PSK consistency. The system of transients calculating is stated accurate within the phase of the signal for the signals of such a type.

articleTitle: The Synthesis of the Structure of Invariant Echo-Compensator Without Protective Time Interval
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: The structure of adaptive echo-compensator which doesn't require protective time interval for its operating is offered.

articleTitle: Detection of Signals on the Background of a Gaussian Noise and Passive Interferences with Unknown Parameters
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: A new approach to detection of signals on the background of a Gaussian noise and passive interferences with unknown parameters based on invariance principle is developed.

articleTitle: The Potential of Flat Curvilinear Doe as a Key Element of Future Integrated Diffractive Optics and Information Protected Element
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: The results of a detailed simulation obtained using a parallel FDTD method and the application of the proposed device to focusing and frequency-selective properties of flat conical diffactive elements in THz waveband are described. Introduction of novels diffractive element in the THz waveband is described. If offers the potential to realize novel types of devices for communications, sensing, integrated optics, networks, transmission lines, information protecting systems and so on. To this end, diffractive planar elements fabricated on non-flat surfaces make it possible to enrich, the "pool of devices" for applications including integrated optics at different waveband, including THz, and to design elements with novel properties and potentials.

articleTitle: Investigation of Magnetic Quantum and Resonance Effects in Semiconductor Systems by Contactless Magneto-Optical and Microwave Methods
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: The investigation of the quantum effects in semiconductors by the contact less magneto-optical and microwave methods are presented. Studies of the dependence of the optical and microwave Shubnikov-de Haas effect (SdH), cyclotron resonance, nonlinear spin resonance on magnetic field have been carried out to determine the transport and energetic parameters in semiconductors such InSb, Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Te and two-dimensional systems (2DS) such GaAs/Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>As in the observation of this effect in the transmission and reflectivity of the probing radiation. The nonlinear spin resonance raised in n-InSb due to stimulated combinational light scattering method (LSCS) with the signal amplification is considered.

articleTitle: Distribution of Electrical Field Over the Lateral Surface of MW Irradiator for Intracavitary Treatment
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Distribution of electrical field over the lateral surface of MW irradiator for intracavitary treatment is considered. The irradiator consists of parallel slots on the lateral surface of a cylindrical probe. It is shown that the field is uniform along the slot and rapidly decreases beyond the slot. Peaks of the field strength are observed just above the slots in the direction across the slots (along the generatrix of the cylinder). To increase the field uniformity in the direction across the irradiator it is recommended to increase the number of slots and, if possible, the slot's width.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Positive and Negative Factors of Influence of a Sound on an Organism of the Man
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: In this work results of the analysis of negative and positive factors are resulted at influence of a sound on an organism of the man. It is shown, that by influence of a sound intensity from 0,02 W/sm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>to 5 W/sm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>and frequencies from 10 Hz to 5000 Hz, a negative consequences of it is not revealed, but positive effects (for example, increase of efficiency and decrease in term of treatment, increase of physiotherapeutic efficiency, amplification of medical effect, increase in a tone and amplitude of reduction of muscles, reduction of side-effects, increase in local blood supply, improvement of function of sounded body) are possible.

articleTitle: Design of Asymmetric Multi-Element Directional Couplers with Tandem Section as the First Element
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: An analysis is presented of a class of asymmetric multi-element directional couplers (ADC) for any number of elements and with tandem section (TS) as the first of its. A table of element values is given for three-and four-element 3-dB couplers for various ripple levels. It is shown that described approach overcomes the tight coupling problem associated with the method proposed by R. Levy, but that it introduces a bandwidth contraction penalty.

articleTitle: Recent Developments in Active Millimeter/Thz Waves High-Quality 3D Imaging for Scientific, Medical and Homeland Security Applications
publicationTitle: 2005 5th International Conference on Microwave Electronics: Measurement, Identification, Applications
abstract: Recent developments in active millimeter/THz waves high-qualtity 3D real-time imaging for scientific, medical and security applications are discussed. Such type of imaging systems affords a compact, simple, fast and relatively low-cost system.
